nodes.title: Downloads
widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`). Same list as downloads.md.

| Need | Folder | File the workflow loads |
|---|---|---|
| required | `diffusion_models/` | [Qwen_Image-Q8_0.gguf](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen_Image-Q8_0.gguf) (generation) |
| optional | `loras/` | [Qwen-Image-Lightning-8steps-V2.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning/resolve/main/Qwen-Image-Lightning-8steps-V2.0.safetensors) (speed LoRA) |
| required | `text_encoders/` | [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) |
| required | `vae/` | [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors) |

- For editing get a quant from [QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF). Other generation quants: [QuantStack/Qwen-Image-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-GGUF).
- 4-step LoRA also available: [Qwen-Image-Lightning-4steps-V2.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning/resolve/main/Qwen-Image-Lightning-4steps-V2.0.safetensors).
- The saved graph loads the text encoder and VAE from a `Qwen-Image/` subfolder. Subfolders are fine: pick your file in the loader once.

**Custom nodes:** [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF).

One command: `python scripts/frizzy.py doctor qwen/image-edit-2509`

nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use

**What it does:** Qwen Image text to image, and Qwen Image Edit 2509 image editing (up to 3 input images), with GGUF models and an optional Lightning speed LoRA. Default: text to image at 1088x1088, 8 steps, CFG 2.

**Inputs (left)**
- **Load Image** x3: only for editing. Bypassed by default. The middle one is image 1 (the image you edit, also resized and VAE-encoded), the bottom one image 2, the top one image 3. Image 2 and 3 are extra references.

**Settings (on the Qwen Image Edit 2509 node)**
- **Prompt / Negative prompt**.
- **Seed** (randomize after each run).
- **Steps / CFG**: 8 steps + CFG 2 with the 8-step LoRA, 4 + CFG 1 with the 4-step LoRA, about 50 + CFG 4 with no LoRA (Qwen team setting).
- **Width / Height**: output size for text to image (1088x1088).
- **LoRA**: the Lightning LoRA file. Match Steps and CFG to it.
- **Model file**: inside the node (double-click it), Step 1, GGUF loader. Default `Qwen_Image-Q8_0.gguf` (generation). For editing pick a Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 GGUF. Smaller quants (Q4_K_S) need less VRAM.

**Text to image (default)**: just Run. Empty Latent goes to the KSampler.

**Editing**
1. Un-bypass the Load Image nodes you use (at least the middle one) and load your images.
2. Open the node. Un-bypass FluxKontextImageScale and VAE Encode in Step 2.
3. Connect the VAE Encode LATENT to the KSampler latent_image (instead of Empty Latent).
4. Pick an Edit-2509 GGUF in Step 1 and write what to change in the Prompt.

Output: `ComfyUI/output/ComfyUI_*.png`.

**Tips**
- At CFG 1 the negative prompt does nothing. Say what you want in positive words.
- Start with the 4-step LoRA to find a good seed fast, then render with 8 steps.

**Attention:** on a 24 GB RTX PRO 4000 (ComfyUI 0.45.3, other workflows) sage, pytorch and ck attention ran at the same speed; --use-sage-attention used less peak VRAM. --use-ck-attention changes the image for the same seed. Not measured on this workflow.

**Tested on:** no tested-on record for this workflow yet. Checked on ComfyUI 0.45.3: converts and validates (not run there).

**Custom nodes:** ComfyUI-KJNodes (GGUF loader), ComfyUI-GGUF. Everything else is core ComfyUI.
